function.name: calculate_tip
function.description: Calculate the total tip amount for a given total bill and tip percentage. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

bill_total.description: The total bill amount. This is a float type value.

tip_percentage.description: The tip percentage. This is a float type value.

split.description: Number of people the tip is split between. Default is 1.

**Top Sushi Spot in Los Angeles** | Restaurant | Address | Highlights | |------------|---------|------------| | **Sushi Gen** | 1120 W 5th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | • Classic Japanese sushi with a focus on fresh fish.
• Known for its “Gen” (genki) vibe and friendly staff.
• Popular dishes: Toro (fatty tuna), Uni (sea urchin), and the signature “Gen Roll.” | | **Sushi Park** | 1220 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015 | • Trendy, modern setting with a sushi bar that’s open 24/7.
• Renowned for creative rolls like the “Sushi Park Roll” (tuna, avocado, cucumber, and spicy mayo).
• Great for both casual diners and special occasions. | | **Sushi Ota** | 1200 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015 | • A hidden gem known for its omakase experience.
• Chef Ota offers a personalized tasting menu featuring seasonal fish.
• Ideal for sushi aficionados looking for an intimate, high-end experience. | ### Why These Stand Out - **Freshness & Quality:** All three restaurants source premium fish from local markets and international suppliers. - **Atmosphere:** From the relaxed, open‑air vibe at Sushi Gen to the sleek, contemporary design at Sushi Park, each offers a unique dining experience. - **Reputation:** Consistently high ratings on Yelp, Google, and food blogs; often featured in LA foodie guides. ### Quick Tips - **Reservations:** For Sushi Ota’s omakase, book well in advance. Sushi Park accepts walk‑ins but can get busy during peak hours. - **Budget:** Sushi Gen offers a range of price points, while Sushi Ota is more upscale. Sushi Park sits in the middle. - **Special Requests:** If you have dietary restrictions or want a specific roll, let the staff know—they’re usually accommodating. Enjoy your sushi adventure in LA!
